name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: The dashboard's pagination row: quiet Previous and Next with chevrons, page squares with the current one on the gray wash, and the page count.
usage: Page through a long list under its table card (monitors, batches, usage). Put PaginationSummary first (Page 2 of 5), disable Previous and Next at the ends, and keep the row 16px under the card. For tables you sort and filter too, use DataTable.
avoid: Infinite scrolling for records people need to find again
More than seven page numbers at once

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
